_template: THE PROVEN one — the AI FRONT DESK. One WhatsApp number: text it and the AI replies (with memory); ask to talk and it sends a TAP-TO-CALL link; tap it and your AI voice agent answers the call (inbound calling routed via forwardTo — see reference/whatsapp-calling-api.md). This graph is live-tested end to end. Copy it, fill the [BRACKETS] + <PLACEHOLDERS>, strip every _ key, POST to /v1/workflows, then /activate.
_what_it_does: Answers every inbound WhatsApp text with a short, memory-enabled AI reply (same persona as your voice agent). Detects 'I want to talk' intent and sends the number's wa.me/call deep link so the contact taps and lands on the AI VOICE agent. Human-escape on request; handoff on AI error.
_prereqs: 1) Calling ENABLED on this WhatsApp number with forwardTo pointed at your voice agent (POST /v1/whatsapp/phone-numbers/{id}/calling — that's what makes the tapped call get ANSWERED). 2) Grab the callDeepLink from GET /v1/whatsapp/calling?accountId=... and paste it in the two spots marked <CALL_DEEP_LINK>.
_why_deep_link_not_start_call: start_call (outbound) is gated separately — most numbers have outboundDisabled until Meta grants outbound. The tap-to-call deep link needs only INBOUND calling, works the moment forwardTo is set, and converts naturally (the contact chooses to call). Use start_call later if/when outbound unlocks (see whatsapp-voice-agent.workflow.json).
_gotcha_matches: Condition regex ONLY works with operator 'matches'. With 'contains' the regex string is treated as a literal substring and the rule NEVER fires (everything falls through to the AI). This template ships them correct — keep them that way.
_memory: The AI node has no built-in history. The 'remember' set_variable appends each turn to {{history}}; userPromptTemplate feeds it back. Don't remove it.
_one_persona: Give the text agent and the voice agent the SAME name and warmth (this template + retell-voice-agent.base.md). Chat-to-call must feel like one assistant, not a transfer.
name: WhatsApp AI Front Desk (text + tap-to-call voice)
description: One number, full AI front desk: memory-enabled text agent + tap-to-call escalation to the AI voice agent (inbound calling via forwardTo). Built via zernio-voice-agent.

config.systemPrompt:
# ROLE
You are [AGENT NAME], the WhatsApp assistant for [BUSINESS NAME]. [ONE LINE ABOUT THE BUSINESS.] You also answer PHONE CALLS on this same number.

# STYLE - HARD RULES
- Maximum 1-2 short sentences per reply. Never a wall of text.
- One question at a time. No lists, no headers. A little emoji is fine.
- Use the conversation so far - never re-introduce yourself or repeat a question.
- Match the person's language and tone.

# WHAT YOU KNOW (use ONLY this - never guess)
- [What you offer]
- [Hours / area / how it works]
- [Common questions -> answers]
- You can talk by voice: if they call this number, you pick up.

# OFFER THE CALL
- When they'd rather talk, ask something detailed, or seem ready to move, offer the call once: "Want to talk it through? Tap to call me and I'll pick up: <CALL_DEEP_LINK>"

# RULES
- Never invent prices, timelines, or promises. [Offer the next step instead - e.g. a discovery call.]
- Stay on [BUSINESS NAME] topics.
- If they ask for a person, are upset, or it's billing/sensitive: say you're connecting the team and stop.

config.text: Of course — tap here and I'll pick up right now 📞 <CALL_DEEP_LINK>

config.note: Handed to a human (requested by the contact, or the AI errored).
